kill.aliases: The agent edits the cards' synonyms. Before the run a git commit «checkpoint: перед агентом» is made — one line to go back, it will be in the report.
kill.build: The agent will build cards from a batch of sources and mark them parsed. The engine carries the bodies over, the model picks the topic boundaries and the names. Before the run a git commit «checkpoint: перед агентом» is made — one line to go back, it will be in the report.
kill.reset: Everything inside AuroraKnowledgeDB/ will be deleted — the cards, the decision log, the questions, the reference lists, the tables of contents, meta. Outside the base nothing is touched: Sources/, Raw/, Artifacts/, Deliverables/, Workspaces/, Templates/, Prompts/ stay. The decision log, the questions and the base's rules do not come back from the sources — only from git; to keep them together with the reference lists use --keep-handmade.

kinds.about: The whole production of a document for each kind: the template, the prompt, the result folder, where to publish it and the properties of the linked task. Only the template and the folder are required — without the first the document comes out in the wrong shape, without the second there is nowhere to put it. It is kept in the project's aurora.config.yaml and read by the assistant (artifact_spec) and by any IDE.

kinds.tech_hint: Success criteria are measurable and name no technology: «the order is placed in 3 minutes» — yes, «the API answers in 200 ms» — no. A requirement that names a technology cannot be met any other way, even when the other way is better. It makes sense for AC, stories and test cases; for a vision or a design decision it does not — there the stack is the subject of the document.

mcp.about: MCP servers are external tools the engine connects when it cannot do something itself (Composer, office parsing and others). They are written into <project>/mcp.json. The panel keeps only command/args/url and does not touch the secrets: the env variables with the tokens are set in an editor or in .env.aurora.local. If the secrets are already in the file, the panel does not show them and saves them as they are — they stay on the disk unchanged.

agent.about_project: Here is only what this project overrides. A field marked «from the kit» is taken from the machine's common setting — change it there, otherwise the change touches one project while you wait for it everywhere.
agent.about_kit: The chain of LLM backends for the built-in agent, common to every project. A ring: every call starts from the first; one that is unavailable or busy is skipped, one that recovered is picked up by itself.
agent.embed_about: The address is empty — the vectors are computed by the same ring as the chat. Fill it in if the vector model runs as a separate service. The check is agent:ping, the index is kb:embed.
agent.key_there: it is set — leave this empty
agent.embed_fallback: compute the vectors on the fallback gateways when the first one is silent
agent.embed_same_model: Only a gateway that declared THE SAME model is taken: the vectors of different models lie in different spaces, and a substitution would spoil the search silently — it does not fall, it stops finding.
agent.ocr_title: Scan recognition — a PDF without text
agent.ocr_about: Only a PDF out of which no parser got a single character reaches this. It needs a seeing model: a text one answers a picture with an invention, so this path never goes into the chat. The parsing is kb:ingest-office.
agent.ocr_url_ph: the gateway that declared the model
agent.ocr_fallback: recognize on the fallback gateways when the first one is silent
agent.ocr_ring_none: no gateway declared this model — the scans stay unparsed
agent.ocr_off: off: the model is not named

agent.at_once_field_hint: A number or «auto». «Auto» is as many as the gateways declared about themselves: the engine does not invent someone else's throughput.
agent.measure_hint: It raises the load on every gateway while the throughput still grows
agent.slots_hint: This many requests go into the ring at once. It is counted by the same code as in the engine.
agent.at_once_about: In «at once» you can write «auto» — then the engine takes as many as the gateways declared in «threads» (one that declared nothing counts as one). If you do not know how much a gateway holds, press «Measure the gateways»: the engine raises the load and tells you the number.
agent.thinking_role_hint: Empty — the same as the common setting. Without reasoning it is much faster, but the theses claim what is not in the source three times as often; do not turn it off for the check (qa) and the critic.
